sentences.significant_rise: The values in this area are rising, and the tests call the rise significant.
sentences.significant_fall: The values in this area are falling, and the tests call the fall significant.
sentences.not_yet: The values lean one way, but the tests cannot yet call it a trend.
sentences.no_trend: The tests found no clear trend. This does not mean that no change is possible: the interval shows the rates that the data still allow.
sentences.record_too_short: The record is shorter than the minimum for this variable, so the card shows the statistics and gives no verdict.
sentences.no_data: No data for this area and time window, so the app tested nothing.

detection_estimate: A detection estimate, not a forecast.

years_needed_reasons.within_record: The record is already as long as the estimate needs, so more years alone may not settle it.
years_needed_reasons.zero_slope: The rate is exactly zero, so no record length would detect it.
years_needed_reasons.no_scatter: The yearly values do not scatter around the trend line, so the app cannot make the estimate.
years_needed_reasons.phi_out_of_range: The yearly values carry over from year to year too strongly for the estimate.

stats_reasons.too_few_values: Fewer than three yearly values, so the app cannot compute the statistics.

notes.methods_disagree: The OLS cross-check and the Mann–Kendall test disagree on this series.

ols_missing.constant_series: Every yearly value is the same, so the OLS cross-check has no p-value and no interval.
ols_missing.n_eff_out_of_range: The yearly values carry over too strongly for the OLS cross-check to give a p-value and an interval.
ols_missing.other: The OLS cross-check has no p-value for this series.

notes.containing_cell: No grid cell center falls inside this area, so the result uses the one cell that contains it.
